docs.string_literal: ISO 10303-21: doubled quotes are escaped quotes.
docs.binary_literal:
The double-quote terminal is %x22: a bare "'" breaks the lexer's
quote pairing.
docs.signature_lines:
ISO 10303-21:2016 clause 14: two signature lines open the header
of a signed exchange structure.
docs.anchor_entry:
ISO 10303-21:2016 clause 9: the anchor section binds labels to
local instances (a promissory anchor binds the unset value).
docs.reference_section:
ISO 10303-21:2016 clause 10: the reference section binds a local
instance name to an external anchor.
docs.exchange_structure:
The section rules carry their own capture (mirroring the DSL),
so the call sites stay bare — an extra `as` here would
double-wrap the subtree.
